# forward_azure_cloud_account (Resource)

An Azure collection source: a service principal, a tenant, and the subscriptions to collect.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) Application (client) ID of the service principal.
- `name` (String) Name of the setup. This is its identity for every other call.
- `network_id` (String)
- `subscription_ids` (List of String) Subscriptions to collect. Forward collects once per subscription.
- `tenant` (String) Directory (tenant) ID.

### Optional

- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret. Forward does not read it back, so Terraform cannot detect a change made elsewhere.
- `collect` (Boolean) Whether Forward collects from this source.
- `delete_on_destroy` (Boolean) Remove the setup from Forward on destroy. Off adopts an existing setup without taking responsibility for removing it.
- `environment` (String) Azure cloud: `AZURE`, `AZURE_US_GOVERNMENT`, `AZURE_CHINA`.
- `proxy_server_id` (String) Proxy collection goes through.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
